name: open-computer-use
description: Open-source cross-platform Computer Use with host adapters, model profiles, and evidence-based recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Control desktop apps with adaptive local Computer Use
interface.longDescription: Open Computer Use V1.1 combines a shared accessibility Runtime with Codex, Claude Code, and WorkBuddy host adapters, GPT and DeepSeek model profiles, sparse bindings, and ten desktop-control tools.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the current UI state of this desktop app without stealing focus when possible
Open a new local document with keyboard shortcuts first, then type content without moving my real pointer unless required
Drive the fixture app and verify the ten computer-use tools still behave correctly
